title: Website product catalog, security contract, quality gate, SEO and image budgets
question: Can the public website reduce cross-session drift and catch route, security, SEO and performance regressions before deployment?
acceptance_criteria: A versioned product catalog is the validation source for public products, markets, routes and store availability.
A dependency-free quality gate checks catalog drift, ownership/privacy contracts, JavaScript syntax, SEO discovery and image budgets.
Required security headers are declared in an edge-applicable contract without falsely claiming GitHub Pages has applied them.
SEO metadata and sitemap/discovery files remain internally consistent.
Existing public routes, app links, language toggle and disabled store buttons remain unchanged for users.
evidence: Owner approved execution of the five prioritized website improvements with merge, deployment and verification.
